unit.why: A brief report, quoted from Keter Shem Tov, of the Besht making an ascent of the soul and seeing the archangel Michael defend Israel. The narrative is minimal but an event does take place. It sits in a thematic anthology section on ascent of the soul.

stories.start_quote: מורי הבעש״ט עשה עליות נשמה וראה
stories.end_quote: או לעשות צדקה וכיו״ב הכל מוכרחים
stories.summary_en: During an ascent of the soul the Besht saw the archangel Michael plead for Israel, arguing that all their sins are really merits, since they cheat only to marry their children to Torah scholars or to give charity.

tags.why: The scene takes place in the upper world during the ascent

quotes: מיכאל אפטרופסא רבא דישראל המליץ עבור ישראל
tags.why: The archangel Michael acts as advocate
A disclosure of how Israel is defended in heaven
Sees what is hidden from others
Charity is the justification Michael gives for Israel's misdeeds

quotes: כדי שיוכלו לעשות שידוך עם ת״ח
tags.why: Matching children with Torah scholars is the motive cited
A cited anthology excerpt whose point is doctrinal (Israel's sins are merits) rather than plot
